prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding tips and a timer to waiting screens was helpful (+8.9%, p=0.0008), matching predictions (+8.0%).
Redesigning path choice screens was helpful (+12.0%, p=0.0), far exceeding predictions (+1.0%).
Adding new screens (new_screen), new guidance flows (new_flow), or path hints (hint) showed no clear effect.
Changing copy (copy), reordering steps (reorder), or adding status indicators/animations showed no clear effect.
Predictions for copy changes, step reordering, hints, and new screens/flows were consistently too high, while predictions for path choice redesign were too low.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +5.9% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: -4.8% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +3.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -2.5% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +12.0% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: +6.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -2.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.0% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -1.1% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 83.9%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Post Setup Desktop Pet Launcher Flow: Add an explicit interactive pet spawn launcher button on the completion screen to help users immediately launch and locate their pet on the desktop. (why: Finish step drops to 64.8% conversion (mean 5815s) and 3 support emails reported pets not showing up or app failing to launch after setup.)
1: [home, wait_info] Background Pet Generation Notification Toggle: Add background desktop notification options on the waiting screen so users know they will be alerted as soon as pet creation completes. (why: Mean wait time during generation is 2336s, causing user anxiety or abandonment while waiting for the pet to build.)
2: [home, notification] Pet Customization Progress Stage Counter: Enable step counters and progress text during generation to inform users about ongoing loading phases. (why: High average waiting time (2336s) leads users to think pet rendering has frozen or failed.)

scores.note: Finish step drops significantly (35.2% drop) and 3 support emails confirm pet launch issues. However, new guidance flows generally show weak or inconsistent effects.
High wait time on home step causes anxiety; wait_info changes have moderate support from past tests, though toggle logic requires non-trivial work.
Targeted at long wait times, but status indicators and animations showed no clear positive effect in historical tests.
